stability: v1 is additive-only: new fields and endpoints may appear, but existing fields are never removed, renamed, or repurposed within v1. Consumers MUST ignore fields they do not recognize. Any breaking change ships as v2 and is announced on status.json with a sunset date at least 90 days out.
